\chapter{Chapter01 — Probability Density Pushforward}

\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{FABL.Chapter01.ProbabilityDensityPushforward}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Pushforward of a probability density]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_eq_one, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.nonneg}
Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $\phi$ be a nonnegative function on $\bbF_2^m$
with uniform expectation $1$, and let $L:\bbF_2^m	o\bbF_2^n$ be any map. The pushforward
density at $z\radicalmathbb{F}_2^n$ is $2^n$ times the uniform expectation over
$y\radicalmathbb{F}_2^m$ of $\phi(y)$ when $L(y)=z$, and of $0$ otherwise.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Pointwise formula for a pushforward density]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward_apply}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward_apply}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward}
\difficulty{1}
Let $m,n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^m$, let
$L:\bbr_2^m\to\bbr_2^n$ be any map, and let $z\in\bbr_2^n$. The pushforward density at
$z$ is $2^n$ times the uniform mean over $y\in\bbr_2^m$ of $\rho(y)$ when $L(y)=z$, and
of $0$ otherwise.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Expectation under a pushforward density]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward_expectation}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward_expectation}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expectation, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.pushforward}
\difficulty{4}
Let $m,n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^m$, let
$L:\bbr_2^m\to\bbr_2^n$ be any map, and let $g:\bbr_2^n\to\bbr$. The expectation of $g$
under the pushforward of $\rho$ by $L$ equals the expectation under $\rho$ of the
function $y\mapsto g(L(y))$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Square of an expectation]
\lean{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.sq_expectation_le_expectation_sq}
\label{FABL.ProbabilityDensity.sq_expectation_le_expectation_sq}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.ProbabilityDensity, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expect_eq_one, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.expectation, FABL.ProbabilityDensity.nonneg}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^n$, and let
$f:\bbr_2^n\to\bbr$. The square of the expectation of $f$ under $\rho$ is at most the
expectation of $f^2$ under $\rho$.
\end{theorem}
